name: Super Bowl LXI (NFL Championship)
source: NFL.com Official Future Super Bowl Sites
description: The annual championship game of the National Football League (NFL) at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
overview: Super Bowl LXI decides the NFL champion for the 2026 season. SoFi Stadium hosts the Vince Lombardi Trophy contest with global kickoff, halftime entertainment, and worldwide telecasts.

name: UEFA Champions League Final
description: European club football pinnacle showdown contested by the top two clubs in Europe at the Estadio Metropolitano.
overview: The UEFA Champions League Final crowns the champion club of Europe. Staged at the Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid, the European showpiece kicks off at 21:00 Central European Summer Time.

name: Wimbledon Gentlemen's Singles Final
description: The Gentlemen's Singles Championship final on Centre Court at the All England Club in Wimbledon.
overview: The 150th anniversary edition of The Championships concludes on Centre Court. The Gentlemen's Singles Final starts at 14:00 BST to decide the Challenge Cup champion.

name: Wimbledon Ladies' Singles Final
description: The Ladies' Singles Championship final played on Centre Court at Wimbledon.
overview: Contested on the final Saturday of the Wimbledon fortnight, the Ladies' Singles Final awards the Venus Rosewater Dish on Centre Court starting at 14:00 British Summer Time.

name: The Masters Tournament (Final Round)
description: Final 18 holes at Augusta National Golf Club awarding the prestigious Green Jacket.
overview: Sunday at Augusta National tests golf's elite through Amen Corner. Leaders tee off in early afternoon Eastern Daylight Time in pursuit of the Green Jacket.

name: Australian Open Men's Singles Final
description: First Grand Slam tournament of the tennis calendar on the blue hard courts of Rod Laver Arena.
overview: The Norman Brookes Challenge Cup is awarded under the night lights of Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne. The men's championship commences at 19:30 Australian Eastern Daylight Time.

name: Roland Garros (French Open) Men's Final
description: The premier red-clay Grand Slam tennis final played on Court Philippe-Chatrier.
overview: The Coupe des Mousquetaires final requires peak physical endurance on the Parisian red clay. Match play begins on Court Philippe-Chatrier at 15:00 Central European Summer Time.

name: US Open Tennis Men's Singles Final
description: Final Grand Slam of the year inside Arthur Ashe Stadium in Flushing Meadows, Queens.
overview: The final Grand Slam title of the season is decided in Arthur Ashe Stadium. The final commences at 16:00 Eastern Daylight Time.

name: Daytona 500 (NASCAR)
description: The 500-mile NASCAR Cup Series season-opening stock car race at Daytona International Speedway.
overview: The Great American Race opens the NASCAR Cup Series with 200 laps of superspeedway drafting. The green flag waves at 14:30 Eastern Standard Time in Daytona Beach, Florida.

name: The Kentucky Derby
description: The Run for the Roses at Churchill Downs, the most storied leg of the American Triple Crown.
overview: The 153rd running of the Kentucky Derby brings twenty 3-year-old thoroughbreds to Churchill Downs. Official post time is set for approximately 18:57 Eastern Daylight Time.

name: Tour de France Final Stage (Champs-Élysées)
description: The ceremonial sprint finish and podium presentation along the Avenue des Champs-Élysées in Paris.
overview: Stage 21 of the Tour de France completes three weeks of Grand Tour racing. The peloton arrives on the cobbles of Paris in the late afternoon around 16:30 Central European Summer Time.

name: The Boston Marathon
description: The 131st edition of the world's oldest annual marathon traversing from Hopkinton to Copley Square.
overview: Staged on Patriots' Day, 30,000 runners navigate the Newton hills and Heartbreak Hill before finishing on Boylston Street. The elite race commences at approximately 09:00 Eastern Daylight Time.

name: Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Opening Ceremony
description: Opening ceremony of the Games of the XXXIV Olympiad in Los Angeles.
overview: In a historic dual-venue celebration between the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum and SoFi Stadium, the LA28 Olympic Opening Ceremony commences around 17:00 Pacific Daylight Time.

name: Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix
description: The Formula 1 street circuit race around the Principality of Monaco.
overview: Official FIA and Formula 1 calendar has not published ratified 2027 race dates on the official page. Status is marked TBC pending official calendar release.

name: ICC Men's Cricket World Cup Final
description: The 50-over One Day International (ODI) World Cup championship match in South Africa.
overview: While scheduled for late 2027 in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, exact match day and start hours are not published on the official ICC site. Status is marked TBC.

name: Indian Premier League (IPL) Final
description: The title clash of the Indian Premier League T20 championship.
overview: Official match timetable and playoff scheduling have not been released on the official portal. Status is marked TBC pending formal announcement.

name: NBA Finals Game 1
description: Opening matchup of the best-of-seven NBA championship series.
overview: Official playoff key dates have not ratified the 2027 Finals opening game date. Status is marked TBC pending calendar release.

name: ICC Men's T20 World Cup Final
description: The 20-over fast-paced international cricket championship final.
overview: While scheduled for late 2028 in Australia and New Zealand, match start hours and final venue allocation remain unratified by the ICC. Status is marked TBC.
